title: Rollout chronicle and root-cause map for branching deployments
creator: Claire Chen
description: Build a chronological 'Rollout Chronicle' surface in Console that stitches time-series metrics, cohort diffs, distributed traces, and infra events into an interactive timeline, and add a Root-Cause Map that highlights likely causal links between metric deltas and trace/infra/model events. Include a rehearsal hub for synthetic shadow replays and a confidence-scored auto-rollback advisor so PMs/engineers can rehearse and recover faster.
acceptance_criteria: Chronicle timeline is available on a per-deployment page and shows aligned lanes for route metrics, cohort diffs, trace spikes, infra events, and model version changes
Root-Cause Map surfaces top 3 correlated signals for any selected metric regression with associated trace sample links
Rehearsal hub can run a scheduled synthetic shadow replay against a target variant and produce a pre-rollout divergence report
Auto-rollback advisor exposes a confidence score (0-100) and recommended rollback scope (route, variant, global) and can be simulated in dry-run mode
All data points link back to Console visualizations and a corresponding GitHub PR or runtime change when available
Feature behind an RBAC-guarded flag and telemetry events emitted for rollout decisions and automated rollback actions
progress_updates: 2025-03-04: Initial PRD drafted; scoped landing surfaces and minimum viable signals (latency P50/P90, error rate, token-cost regression, perplexity sample).
2025-03-05: Architecture sync with infra and runtime teams. Decided to leverage existing trace sampling pipeline; added an ingestion adapter for cohort diff deltas.
2025-03-06: Design reviewed first mockups (Figma) — introduced lane-grouping and zoom-to-range behavior. Design feedback: avoid unlimited lane stacking; group by signal types.
2025-03-07: ENG dependency ENG-49820 identified (model-change event schema). Product requested event contract by 2025-03-14.

2025-03-10: Implementing backend aggregator for aligned timestamps; prototype queries for correlating diffs with trace spikes completed. Found trade-off between query latency and retention; agreed to compute pre-aggregates for 30d retention.
decisions: Show only top-level cohorts by default and expose full cohort selector in advanced mode to reduce cognitive load.
Use a confidence-scored heuristic combining delta magnitude, sample size, and trace-error-rate for initial root-cause ranking.
Auto-rollback will be opt-in per-customer and require two independent signals (one metric threshold + one trace-derived anomaly) before recommending immediate rollback.
risks: Correlation does not imply causation — false positives in root-cause map may erode trust. Mitigation: show provenance and sampling coverage.
Querying high-cardinality cohort diffs at interactive latency risks high infra cost. Mitigation: precompute daily aggregates and provide on-demand deeper queries with progress feedback.
Auto-rollback misfires could impact customers. Mitigation: require opt-in and dry-run simulation before activation; introduce manual confirmation flows.
next_steps: Finalize event contract with runtime team (deadline 2025-03-14).
Complete backend pre-aggregate schema and integration tests (owner: ENG).
Design handoff: final mocks and accessibility review (owner: Design).
Implement rehearsal hub basic runner and sample divergence report (owner: ENG).
Prepare canary for internal customers and schedule a pilot with two platform teams.
notes_from_reviews: Design review (2025-03-06): Claire — prefer 'lane focus' interactions; add keyboard shortcuts for power users.
Security review (initial, 2025-03-09): Security — rehearsal hub must not leak production PII; recommend tokenization and KMS-backed redaction.
ENG sync (2025-03-05): Ravi — expensive correlated queries should be async with progress UI; propose nightly pre-aggregates.
rollback_policy_summary: Triggering conditions: metric delta > configured threshold AND trace-error-rate spike > configured threshold within window
Scope decisions: advisor recommends rollback scope with highest expected reduction in regression (route > variant > global)
Confidence scoring: aggregated from magnitude, sample size, cross-cohort consistency, and prior incident similarity (0-100)
Dry-run mode: advisor can simulate past rollouts to produce a 'would-have-rolled-back' report for calibration
monitoring_signals: Error rate (5xx, parsing errors, hallucination sampling flag)
Token cost per request and per-route cost delta
Cohort divergence score (KL / edit-distance on outputs where applicable)
Trace span count and tail latency spikes
Model-change events and image of new artifact (model id, quantization profile)
customer_notes: Pilot customers will be informed about rehearsal hub and opt-in auto-rollback before the pilot window.
Provide a short FAQ for customer admins covering safety controls, opt-in, and data retention.
qa_plan: Unit tests for pre-aggregate composer and query planner
Integration tests replaying historical traffic and validating divergence reports
Chaos run: simulate an infra spike and verify Root-Cause Map surfaces correct infra events
User acceptance: run pilot with two internal product teams and collect UX feedback
